title: Regularized free deconvolution for spectral repair of resampling distortion in high-dimensional particle filters
abstract: arXiv:2610.23448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Resampling is the standard remedy for weight degeneracy in particle filters, but in high dimensions it distorts the spectrum of the ensemble covariance in a way that is computable from the importance weights. This paper studies the inverse problem: recovering the pre-resampling spectrum from the observed weights and the empirical spectrum alone, and using it without biasing the filter. We first show that the forward spectral law extends to random importance weights once one conditions on the weights together with the realized offspring counts, rather than on the weights alone. We then construct a regularized free-deconvolution estimator, prove its consistency with an explicit error budget at a fixed resolution scale, and certify model mismatch through a computable forward residual. translated_title: 用于高维粒子滤波器中重采样失真谱修复的正则化自由反卷积
translated_abstract: 重采样是解决粒子滤波器中权重退化问题的标准方法，但在高维情形下，它会以一种可以从重要性权重计算出来的方式扭曲集合协方差的谱。本文研究由此产生的逆问题：仅凭观测到的权重和经验谱恢复重采样前的谱，并在不使滤波器产生偏差的情况下加以使用。我们首先证明，一旦以权重及其实际产生的后代数量共同作为条件（而不仅仅是权重本身），前向谱定律便可推广到随机重要性权重的情形。随后，我们构造了一个正则化自由反卷积估计器，证明了其在固定分辨率尺度下的一致性并给出显式误差预算，同时通过一个可计算的前向残差来检验模型失配。修复后的谱仅作为 Metropolis 修正的复活移动的预条件子进入滤波器，因此谱误差只会影响混合效率……
tldr: 该论文提出一种正则化自由反卷积估计器，仅凭重要性权重和经验谱即可恢复高维粒子滤波器中因重采样而失真的协方差谱，并将其作为预条件子用于 Metropolis 修正的复活移动，在不引入偏差的情况下提升滤波器的混合效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a regularized free-deconvolution estimator that recovers the pre-resampling covariance spectrum distorted by resampling in high-dimensional particle filters using only importance weights and the empirical spectrum, and applies it as the preconditioner of a Metropolis-adjusted rejuvenation move to improve mixing efficiency without biasing the filter.
